questions.stem: Which device converts kinetic energy into electrical energy?
questions.explanation: A generator converts kinetic (mechanical) energy into electrical energy using electromagnetic induction. A motor does the opposite -- it converts electrical energy into kinetic energy. A transformer changes voltage levels but does not convert between energy types.

questions.stem: Which Fleming's rule is used for motors and which is used for generators?

options.text: Left-hand rule for motors, right-hand rule for generators
Right-hand rule for motors, left-hand rule for generators

questions.explanation: Fleming's left-hand rule is used for the motor effect (finding the force on a current-carrying conductor in a field). Fleming's right-hand rule is used for generators (finding the direction of induced current in a moving conductor). Remember: Left = motor, Right = generator.
